# HarvestRules

`harvest`

Tuning for working and moving a creature body: how long a harvest takes, how close the harvester stands, how carrying and dragging slow the walk, and how many bodies a region keeps.

> Keep harvest and carry numbers in the design bible so balance is a single-source edit

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| harvestSeconds | decimal | Seconds a harvest action runs; moving or taking damage cancels it |
| harvestRangeMetres | decimal | Distance in metres within which the host accepts a harvest or carry intent |
| carrySlowAboveFraction | decimal | Carrying a body heavier than this fraction of the capacity slows walking |
| carrySlowSpeedMultiplier | decimal | Walk speed multiplier while carrying above carrySlowAboveFraction |
| dragCapacityFactor | decimal | A \`drag\` body up to capacity times this factor can be dragged |
| dragSpeedMultiplier | decimal | Walk speed multiplier while dragging a body |
| carryBonusPerSkinningLevelKg | decimal | Extra carry capacity in kg per Skinning level, on top of the Strength-derived capacity (AttributeSystem.derivation.carryCapacityKg) |
| maxCarcassesPerRegion | integer | Bodies a region keeps; the oldest decays first |
